neighbours.label: the modal ' can' (ability / possibility)
fire: The program shows every line where the word can be found in the file.
Well, from here I can see the whole harbor and the boats.
If prices keep falling, then we can say goodbye to the old plan.
Get up now, you can sit on the chair by the window.
This kind of muscle can contract for a short time without tiring.
In the evening the children can play in the yard until dark.
With a good map, anyone can find the trail to the lake.
The machine can print forty pages in a minute.
quiet: The program shows every line where the word will be printed in the file.
Well, from here I must walk to the harbor and the boats.
If prices keep falling, then we should say goodbye to the old plan.
Get up now, you must sit on the chair by the window.
This kind of muscle will contract for a short time without tiring.
In the evening the children played in the yard until dark.
With a good map, anyone should find the trail to the lake.
The machine printed forty pages in a minute.

notes: Card: ' can' is 29 of the top 32 (plus Arabic يمكن, French pouvez). The output promotes ' possible', ' available', ' able'. The + pole peaks on the word after a modal, and on could/also. Near misses use other modals (will, should, must) in the same frames.
